title: Fulmetry worker method contract
description: The shape of each contracts/worker/<method>.json. The worker validates params and results with them; maker-tools turns each into an MCP tool.

description.description: What the method does, for people and agents (becomes the MCP tool description)

timeoutMs.description: How long a caller should wait for one call before giving up on the worker

readOnly.description: True when the method writes no files; such a call may be retried after a worker crash (MCP readOnlyHint)
